QUOTE: in the default configuration, the library runs no concurrency of its own and takes no locks. ... The concurrent code the index finds is in `programs/`, not in the library.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no concurrency, but it never says that a default build creates no threads at all. It also says the pthread example (`ssl_pthread_server.c`) is a real multi-threaded consumer, not that it compiles to a stub main.
